director_research_note.title: Analyzing Semantic Faithfulness of Language Models via Input Intervention on Question Answering
director_research_note.measurement_transfer: Training that improved support-deletion behavior did not establish sensitivity to negation or predicate-argument structure. Apply the distinction to measurement, without adopting this paper’s data or training method.

separate_measures.notebook_removal: Record whether the model abstains appropriately when support is absent. This cannot qualify evidence-sensitive answer changes.
separate_measures.meaning_changing_evidence: Separately record whether a byte-identical human question receives the incompatible answer supported by each approved human context. Correct direction matters, not merely any output change.
separate_measures.compatible_or_irrelevant_changes: Report stability separately if an approved eligible pair exists; do not synthesize text to fill a missing control.
separate_measures.claims: Keep these counts separate. Neither optimization/memorization nor support-deletion success proves semantic faithfulness.

16_row_alternative: UNRELEASED optimization/memorization diagnosis: 16 existing human TRAIN rows times 50 visits = 800 batch-one updates per seed. Not a notebook-dependence or generality test.
